title: First In, First Out: Stop Throwing Food Away

scenes.say: New tub goes in front. The old one slides to the back. And ends up in the trash.

props.label: THE WALK-IN
props.line: New in front. *Old in the trash.*

scenes.say: Say that's fifty dollars of food a week, lost at the back of the walk-in. Times fifty-two weeks. That's two thousand six hundred dollars a year.

props.caption: Lost at the *back of the shelf*
props.label: a year

scenes.say: And it's not just money. Most health codes say ready-to-eat food you make has seven days in the fridge, counting the day it's made.

props.caption: Myth or *fact*?
props.myth: If it smells fine, it's fine
props.fact: Ready-to-eat food you make: 7 days in the fridge, max

scenes.say: So: put new stock behind the old. Label everything with the day it was made. And check the back of the shelf every morning.

props.title: First in, first out
steps: New stock goes behind the old
Label it with the day it's made
